title.en: It holds or it does not

t.zh: <level-ref to="c-wall"></level-ref>里，auto 证不出「下雨 ∨ ¬下雨」，<wiki-ref to="lem"></wiki-ref>的一例。先证一句弱一些的：「¬¬(下雨 ∨ ¬下雨)」，否认它就会矛盾。
t.en: In <level-ref to="c-wall"></level-ref>, auto could not prove “it rains ∨ ¬it rains”, an instance of <wiki-ref to="lem"></wiki-ref>. First a weaker sentence: “¬¬(it rains ∨ ¬it rains)”, that denying it is a contradiction.

after.zh: 没有双重否定消去的规则，是<wiki-ref to="intuitionistic"></wiki-ref>；加上它，就是<wiki-ref to="classical"></wiki-ref>。经典命题逻辑里，真值表上每一行都真的句子都证得出。
after.en: The rules without double-negation elimination are <wiki-ref to="intuitionistic"></wiki-ref>; with it, <wiki-ref to="classical"></wiki-ref>. In classical propositional logic, every sentence true on every row has a proof.

hint.zh: 要证的是一个否定，不必证出「或者」的哪一边。
hint.en: The goal is a negation; neither side of the “or” has to be proved.

hint.zh: 假设「¬(下雨 ∨ ¬下雨)」，这个假设要用两次。
hint.en: Assume “¬(it rains ∨ ¬it rains)”; that assumption is used twice.

t.zh: 由 ¬¬A 推出 A，叫双重否定消去。现有的规则推不出它，只能作为一条加进证明核：。
t.en: From ¬¬A, infer A: this is double-negation elimination. The rules so far cannot derive it; it can only come into the kernel as an , .

hint.zh: 刚才的证明已经给出「¬¬(下雨 ∨ ¬下雨)」。
hint.en: The proof you just made already gives “¬¬(it rains ∨ ¬it rains)”.

hint.zh: 把<part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref>接在最外层假设框的输出后面。
hint.en: Wire <part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref> after the outermost assumption box.
